description: Attestation for API purification scheme execution per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 4. Records recrystallization solvent / yield, activated charcoal decolorization, filtration, and (chlorpheniramine only) prep-HPLC ICH M7 PGI removal step.

scheme.description: Wave 1: 'recryst-charcoal-filter' (DSCG / naphazoline); 'recryst-charcoal-filter-prephplc' (chlorpheniramine, ICH M7 4-chlorobenzyl chloride removal). Wave 1b extensions: 'recryst-only' (clotrimazole / diclofenac), 'recryst-double' (acetaminophen / aspirin), 'recryst-charcoal-only' (ibuprofen / famotidine), 'trituration-wash' (diphenhydramine HCl salt), 'vacuum-distillation' (loratadine / cetirizine). Wave 1c chiral: 'crystalline-resolution-mandelate' (omeprazole S-enantiomer via L-mandelic acid salt), 'prep-hplc-chiral' (Chiralcel OD-H or equiv), 'SFC-supercritical' (deferred Wave 1c+).

recoveryYieldBp.description: Purification recovery yield in basis points (10000 = 100%).

charcoalLoadingBp.description: Activated charcoal loading in basis points of crude mass (10000 = 100%).

filtrationPoreSizeNm.description: Filtration pore size in nanometers (integer). 450 = standard 0.45 µm clarification; 220 = 0.22 µm sterile-grade.

prepHplcFractionPurityBp.description: Required when scheme = '*-prephplc'. Purity in basis points (10000 = 100%).

residualSolventEstimatePpm.description: Residual solvent estimate in parts per million (integer).

pgiEstimatePpb.description: Required for chlorpheniramine (4-chlorobenzyl chloride). Estimate in parts per billion (integer; ppm × 1000 for trace-level precision). Auto-reject if computed daily exposure > ICH M7 Class 1B 1.5 µg/day.
